bullets_en: Journey of 9 days: Fan walks from Kurnool to meet CM Revanth.
Jogu Ramanna accuses MP, MLA of neglecting Adilabad.
Chavara to get rehabilitation centre for differently abled children.
Magnitude-6.1 earthquake hits off Tokyo, no tsunami alert: weather agency.
bullets_ur: 9 din ka safar: CM Revanth se milnay ke liye fan Kurnool se paidal chala.

Chavara mein khususi bachon ke liye rehabilitation centre qaim kiya jayega.
